tools.name: ADD
tools.summary: One offline app: the 4,373-icon browser, the fonts page, a photo editor with signed font packs, and batch compression.
features: One package: the icon browser, the fonts page, the editor and the compressor, no second app to install.
Icons: four brands, 4,373 glyphs, the same catalogs the site publishes.
Fonts: the three bundled faces plus signed packs fetched on request from the site, verified before install.

Editor: photo, type, presets and live adjustments, a colour mixer with hex and RGB, type spacing and opacity, photo turn/flip and canvas colour, reorderable layers with visibility, and installed packs kept for offline use.
Compress: real quality, downscale, batch up to 40 photos, metadata stripped, originals untouched.
Internet for one job only: a font pack you tap in Font packs; the shelf, the editor and Compress otherwise run offline.
Same four palettes and the side tab as the site, including the look controls at its foot.
